description: This file defines an interface IFrontPanel for controlling and querying a hardware front panel's lights, LEDs, and brightness settings within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for configuring the panel, getting and setting brightness, controlling LEDs, and setting blink patterns.

classes.name: IFrontPanel
classes.description: An interface for controlling the front panel hardware components such as lights, LEDs, and brightness levels.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes or configures the front panel with the given service environment.

methods.name: GetBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the brightness level for a specified index, indicating success.

methods.name: GetFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported front panel lights and their info, indicating success.

methods.name: PowerLedOff
methods.description: Turns off a specified LED indicator, indicating success.

methods.name: PowerLedOn
methods.description: Turns on a specified LED indicator, indicating success.

methods.name: SetBlink
methods.description: Sets a blinking pattern for an LED based on provided JSON blink info, indicating success.

methods.name: SetBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness for a specified index, indicating success.

methods.name: SetLED
methods.description: Sets an LED indicator with specified brightness, color, and RGB components, indicating success.

calls: Core::hresult SetLED(const string&, uint32_t, const string&, uint32_t, uint32_t, uint32_t, FrontPanelSuccess&)

ctags.name: IFrontPanel
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IFrontPanel : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
